categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The load request q is read from data.q.data, matching the documented raw-body response path without unnecessary bindings.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The keyless CoinMarketCap request uses the verified endpoint, exact asset IDs, USD conversion, load trigger, and a reasonable 60-second cache.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The template uses documented data and status roots, RefreshButton, supported number formatting, and the safe UTC date helper.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: Each requested asset shows price, signed 24-hour change, market cap, volume, refresh context, and its source update time.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: The price hierarchy, compact stat grid, spacing, and semantic badges scan clearly, but the repeated plain rows do not feel especially premium or distinctive.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: SimpleGrid with minColWidth 140 can reduce the stats to one column, while min-width guards and truncation protect names, although the fixed-height loading skeleton is not very adaptive.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: The template has explicit loading skeleton, request-error alert, empty-data text, and populated-list states.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: A refresh control and complete market snapshot support monitoring, but repeated per-asset timestamps and identical detail rows make the narrow-tile scan denser than necessary.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: There is one request and no dead control, but every asset repeats a full responsive stats grid and update line for this three-item list.
categoryReasons.accessibility: Asset names, metric labels, numeric percentage signs, and update times remain visible as text, with the refresh helper providing the control.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: The widget performs only a read-only load query and exposes no mutation or unsafe action.

strengths: Verified keyless endpoint and exact ID filter avoid ambiguous symbol matching.
All requested market metrics and update context are present.
Responsive stat grid and explicit request states are useful for a compact tile.
problems: The repeated metadata and timestamp rows feel functional rather than premium.
The fixed 210px loading skeleton is less tailored to narrow tile height than the success layout.
highestImpactFixes: Strengthen visual hierarchy with a more deliberate compact summary while keeping the current responsive metric layout.
Reduce repeated per-asset timestamp and row overhead where it does not improve scanning.
